title.value: Assessing the impact of aircraft arrival on ambient ultrafine particle number concentrations in near-airport communities in Boston, Massachusetts
title.justification: The paper's title explicitly indicates that the study focuses on assessing the impact of aircraft arrivals on ambient ultrafine particle concentrations in communities near airports, specifically in Boston, Massachusetts.
title.quote: Assessing the impact of aircraft arrival on ambient ultrafine particle number concentrations in near-airport communities in Boston, Massachusetts

extractions.description: The study evaluates the impact of aircraft arrivals on ultrafine particle concentrations in near-airport communities around Boston Logan International Airport. It examines real-time aircraft activity and meteorological data to assess how aircraft influence particle number concentrations, focusing on identifying aviation contributions amidst other urban sources of ultrafine particles.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The study focuses on how aviation emissions from aircraft arrivals contribute to ambient air pollution, specifically ultrafine particles, which aligns with ecological sustainable development concerns about air quality and public health impacts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.

primary_category.justification: The central theme of the paper is the assessment of ultrafine particle pollution attributed to aircraft arrivals, as they contribute to air pollution in communities near airports.
primary_category.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.

secondary_categories.justification: The study indirectly relates to climate change mitigation by aiming to understand and possibly reduce aviation-related air pollution, which is a component of broader efforts to mitigate transportation emissions.
secondary_categories.quote: Disentangling these contributions can be challenging, as emission patterns, composition of particles, particle size, and dispersion characteristics can differ substantially, given the unique plume dynamics of aviation activities.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper's primary focus on measuring and analyzing ultrafine particle concentrations from aircraft emissions directly fits into the air pollution category.
primary_sub_category.quote: Aircraft emissions contribute to overall ambient air pollution, including ultrafine particle (UFP) concentrations.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The study focuses on aircraft arrivals, part of the transportation sector, and how they contribute to local air pollution, relating to transportation sustainability issues.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The objective of this study was to evaluate the impact of arrival aircraft on particle number concentration (PNC), a proxy for UFP.

applications.value: Understanding aviation's contribution to ultrafine particle pollution
applications.justification: The study's application focuses on quantifying and understanding how aircraft contribute to ultrafine particle pollution in nearby communities, aiding in air quality management and policy development.
applications.quote: Our findings suggest strong but intermittent contributions from arrival aircraft to ambient PNC in communities near airports.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's focus on air pollution and its ties to aviation contributions does not require the creation of a new category, as it fits well within the 'Pollution' category.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on ultrafine particles and their contribution to air pollution aligns with the existing 'Air Pollution' sub-category, so a new sub-category is not necessary.
